label: Diagram 3.17
caption: Diagram 3.17 Examples of wheelchair accessible bathrooms with both bath and shower
description: This drawing shows two bathroom floor plans, Example 3.17A above and Example 3.17B below. In 3.17A the top dimension line reads 3100mm, with 1000mm, 800mm, 450mm and 150mm marked; the left edge is 2200mm overall with 1700mm and 1200mm marked, the right edge 750mm. The plan contains a bath top left, a WC top right, a basin on the right, and a door with a swing arc at bottom right. Dashed lines and circles mark access and turning zones, with a leader to "1000 x 1000 x 100mm zone kept clear to enable fitting of rails." Its caption reads "Example 3.17A – wheelchair accessible bathroom with bath and 1000 x 1200mm shower with capacity for larger shower if bath removed." In 3.17B the top line reads 2900mm split into 700mm, 1000mm and 1200mm; the left edge is 2600mm with 1700mm and 800mm; the right edge shows 150mm, 1200mm, 800mm and 450mm. It shows a bath at left, a WC bottom right, a basin bottom left and a door with swing arc at the bottom, with dashed zone markings and the same rails note. Its caption reads "Example 3.17B – wheelchair accessible bathroom with bath and 1200 x 1200mm shower." Notes state dimensions are for illustration only, WC doors must open outwards, and stack and drainage positions must be clear of access zones.
